page_topic_one_liner: Navigation menu SEO — header/footer/mobile nav types, hierarchy, internal linking, and crawlability best practices
differentiator_vs_generic: This is site navigation structure and internal linking UX, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a website header wireframe with horizontal nav bar and dropdown sitemap tree, NOT an AI site builder or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Website header wireframe — horizontal nav bar with 5 items (Home, Products▾, Blog, Docs, Contact), expanded dropdown panel showing 3 sub-links, mars-green accent on active nav item
Secondary: site hierarchy tree diagram (root → category → page nodes) showing internal link equity flow
Tertiary: mobile hamburger menu tear-out (3-line icon + stacked vertical links blur)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is navigation SEO not GEO)
Generic compass icon alone without nav wireframe
App store or dashboard sidebar unrelated to website navigation
